# Station Engineer [color=#f39f27]Engineering[/color] is a combination of [textlink="construction" link="Construction"] work, repair work, maintaining a death machine that happens to produce [textlink="power" link="Power"].
## Personnel [color=#f39f27]Engineering[/color]'s staff is made up of Station Engineers, Atmospheric Technicians, and Firefighters.
## Tools
Your core toolset is a small variety of tools. If you're an engineer, then you will get one in your locker containing one of each. If not however, you can likely find them in maintenance shafts within assorted toolboxes, tool storage, and vending machines found within engineering.
Your primary task as an engineer is setting up and maintaining the [textlink="AME" link="AME"] for power. After that, you are generally tasked with keeping up the power through other means and repairs around the station.
